action.command: for ep in /v1/events /v1/news /v1/categories /v1/pois; do echo -n "$ep => "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" "http://127.0.0.1$ep"; done; echo "=== events content ==="; curl -s -H "Host: api.workspace.localhost" "http://127.0.0.1/v1/events?size=2" | head -c 500

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "for ep in /v1/events /v1/news /v1/categories /v1/pois; do echo -n \"$ep => \"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" -H \"Host: api.workspace.localhost\" \"http://127.0.0.1$ep\"; done; echo \"=== events content ===\"; curl -s -H \"Host: api.workspace.localhost\" \"http://127.0.0.1/v1/events?size=2\" | head -c 500", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Query seeded events endpoint"}
